Summary: PDP || Product price displayed on the Product Detail Page does not match the price shown in the Cart.
Description:
*Steps to Reproduce:*

# Launch the website.
# Navigate to the *Product Listing* page.
# Open the Product Detail Page of any product (e.g., *Diya Diamond Finger Ring*).
# Note the product price displayed on the Product Detail Page.
# Click *Add to Cart*.
# Navigate to the *Cart* page.
# Compare the product price displayed in the cart with the price shown on the Product Detail Page.

*Actual Result:*
The product price displayed on the *Product Detail Page* is different from the price displayed in the *Cart*.

*Expected Result:*
The product price displayed in the *Cart* should exactly match the price shown on the *Product Detail Page*, ensuring pricing consistency throughout the purchase journey.

Summary: PDP || Ring product can be added to the cart without selecting a Ring Size.
Description:
*Steps to Reproduce:*

# Launch the website.
# Navigate to the Product Detail Page of any *Ring* product.
# Do not select a *Ring Size*.
# Click the *Add to Cart* button.
# Observe the application behavior.

*Actual Result:*
The ring product is successfully added to the cart even though no *Ring Size* has been selected.

*Expected Result:*
The user should not be able to add a ring product to the cart without selecting a *Ring Size*. A validation message (e.g., *"Please select a ring size."*) should be displayed, and the product should only be added after a valid size is selected.

Summary: Cart || Adding the same product with a different size updates the quantity instead of creating a separate cart entry, resulting in incorrect size information.
Description:
*Steps to Reproduce:*

# Launch the website.
# Navigate to the Product Detail Page of a size-dependent product (e.g., a ring).
# Select *Size 2* and add the product to the cart.
# Navigate back to the same product.
# Select a different size (e.g., *Size 4*) and add it to the cart.
# Open the *Cart* page.
# Observe the cart details.

*Actual Result:*
Instead of creating a separate cart entry for the new size, the cart updates the quantity from *1 to 2*, and the newly selected size overlaps/replaces the previously selected size.

*Expected Result:*
Products with different selected sizes should be treated as separate cart items. Each cart entry should retain its respective size, and the quantity should only increase when the *same product with the same size* is added again.

Summary: Wishlist || Product image and price do not update when changing the Metal Color in the Add to Bag side panel opened from the Wishlist.
Description:
*Steps to Reproduce:*

# Launch the website.
# Add any product to the *Wishlist*.
# Navigate to the *Wishlist* page.
# Click the *Add to Bag* button for any wishlist item.
# In the Product Detail side panel, select a different *Metal Color*.
# Observe the product image and price.
# Open the same product on its standard *Product Detail Page (PDP)*.
# Change the *Metal Color* and compare the behavior.

*Actual Result:*
In the *Add to Bag* side panel, changing the *Metal Color* does not update the product image or price. However, on the standard *Product Detail Page (PDP)*, both the product image and price update correctly after selecting a different metal color.

*Expected Result:*
Changing the *Metal Color* in the *Add to Bag* side panel should update the product image and price in the same way as the standard *Product Detail Page (PDP)*, ensuring consistent functionality across both interfaces.

Summary: CART || Engraving option is displayed in the Cart for products that do not support engraving.

# Observe the product options.

*Expected Result:*

Summary: BAG || Engraving text disappears after modifying and saving the engraving from the Cart.

# Log out of the application.
# Add any product to the *Cart*.
# Proceed to *Checkout* and select *Continue as Guest*.
# Enter the *same email address* that is already registered.
# Complete the checkout process and place the order.
# Observe the application behavior.

*Actual Result:*
The application allows the order to be placed successfully using an email address that is already associated with a registered account. No validation or error message is displayed.

*Expected Result:*

If the entered email is already registered, it should display an appropriate message (e.g., *"This email is already registered. Please sign in to continue."*) or prompt the user to log in instead of allowing the transaction to proceed as a guest.
